translationRepairs: For Huangboluo Valley in Liaoyang and Dakaijinchang in Kaiyuan, I request a permanent ban on mining, as at Dabei Ridge in Jinzhou."
For Huangboluo Valley in Liaoyang and the Dajinchang gold workings in Kaiyuan, I request a permanent ban on mining, as at Dabei Ridge in Jinzhou."
The source lists two mining localities, 遼陽黃波羅峪 and 開原打金廠. The existing Dakaijinchang fuses 打金廠 with the preceding 開原; Dajinchang should be kept as the locality name and glossed for clarity.
